name: Yin Release Adept: Black Fang – Future Denial

system.description:
You focus Yin chakra into your palms and strike at the temple of your foe. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Denial Palm Strike.

Denial Palm Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a saving throw, using their associated jutsu modifier of the target discipline. On a failure, you inject Yin chakra into them, fragmenting their memories. Select one casting discipline between Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Genjutsu and Bukijutsu; and one rank between E-Rank, D-Rank, C-Rank, B-Rank and A-Rank, for the next minute they cannot cast jutsu of the select discipline and rank. A creature affected by this remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.
